prompt: A team publishes a utility library with no LICENSE file. What may others legally assume they can do with the code?
explanation: Copyright does not vanish when code becomes public. Without an explicit license, nobody receives reuse, modification, or distribution rights — the default is "all rights reserved". Choosing and committing a license grants those permissions.

options.text: Nothing beyond viewing it — without a license, all rights stay with the authors
They may reuse it freely because it is public
Public code is automatically placed in the public domain
The MIT license applies by default to public repositories
